When clicked and success, no alert, but change the link text to "copied" for 2 seconds and then back.
conversations.answer: Certainly! Here's the revised script to position the "copy" link relative to the outer div and change its text upon a successful copy operation without displaying an alert.[CODE_BLOCK_0]This revised script correctly positions the "copy" link relative to the outer div, and upon a successful copy operation, changes the link text to "copied" for 2 seconds before reverting it back to "copy".

conversations.prompt: Underline the copy link and disable page loading when clicking on it. Also alert and console.warn as error handling
conversations.answer: Certainly! I've made the necessary modifications to the code. Now the "copy" link is underlined, and clicking on it won't trigger a page load. In the event of an error during the copy operation, an alert is displayed, and a warning message is logged to the console.[CODE_BLOCK_0]These changes ensure that the "copy" link is styled with an underline, and clicking on it neither triggers a page load nor an error without proper handling.
